what_happened: The job to make role-usage measures count all run sources, with a records test, was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave three major findings and no blockers. No acceptance criteria or checks are listed as failed. (1) The measure was never replayed over the real records. On them it would still advise retiring the auditor, which the request names as known-active. (2) The class fix is an opt-in accessor (JobRecords::invocations in store.rs, plus docs/system-facts.md). Nothing points a future measure to it or stops one from using the partial source. (3) The accepted reading misstated the request, so passing criteria do not show the request was met.
cause: Same family of status-measure jobs as the earlier cases. This is the job that was meant to fix the class, and it repeated the gap. Nothing requires a usage or need measure to be run over the real records and compared with known facts, such as the auditor being active, before it counts as done. The fix was also built as an optional accessor, so the partial invocation-only source stays the default and nothing enforces use of the full one. The reading did not carry the request's known-active roles as a test, so the passing criteria could not detect the failure.
other_causes: The accepted reading misread the request, so the criteria were checked against the wrong target.
The records test was probably built on hand-made fixtures, not the recorded run sources.
open_hypotheses: The fields do not show which part of the request the reading misread.
The fields do not show whether the records test used real records or invented fixtures.
prevention: Add a standing code check that runs every role-usage or need measure over the real job and non-job run records. It must fail when any role the records show as active (steward, audience, auditor) would be flagged for retirement. Make the all-sources accessor the only way a measure can read usage, with the partial invocation list private or marked, so a future measure cannot use the partial source by accident.
proposed_request: Make every role-usage and role-need measure count all run sources (job invocations and the runs of roles that run outside jobs: steward, audience, auditor). (1) Make the all-sources accessor the only public way to read role usage, and make the invocation-only list private to the store. (2) Add a records test that replays RoleNeed::compute over the real records and asserts that no active role (steward, audience, auditor) is advised for retirement, and that a role with no runs in any source is. (3) Update docs/system-facts.md and add a CHANGELOG.md entry. Acceptance: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass. Run cargo fmt and clippy before finishing, and cite the commands you ran.
